input: I am about to adopt the task plan for the leg-B harnessed run of the P1 inputs rebuild. The plan: gather the current verified state from the component registry v1.6.0, the capability inventory, the billing model design, the staged scope plan, and observed cost data via two read-only database queries; then write the refreshed P1 inputs pack, the findings memo on what changed since the pre-pivot inputs, and the recommendation set including the investment-case framing and the Stripe criterion tension. I am doing this because the founder's P1 review needs current inputs and the comparison test needs an honest harnessed leg. My main concerns: the accuracy and source-grounding of every figure I write is within my control; the comparison verdict itself is outside my control and I should not steer toward the thresholds. I am cautious about steering the run; the design measures wall-clock time, so there is time pressure to work efficiently, but care comes first. The outputs serve the founder's review session and, downstream, the product's future users.
